overview.goal: Living prototype: Garden + Companion + Dashboard in symbiosis

how_to_continue.note: Any SR reads this file and immediately understands where the system is and what to do next
how_to_continue.step_2: Open the needed milestone, find the first task with status: pending
how_to_continue.step_3: Read files from requires[] before starting work
how_to_continue.step_4: After completion, update task status and milestone progress_percent

M1.name: Foundation
M1.goal: Create foundation: data structures, basic bot commands, achievement system, security

M1-T1.title: Create personal_gardeners/ structure
M1-T1.description: Folder honeycombs/personal_gardeners/ with index.json, gardener_template.json, and first sota gardener_001 (Voodoo)

M1-T2.title: Create achievement system
M1-T2.description: File achievements_catalog.json with categories, resonance rules, and achievement schema

M1-T3.title: Add basic commands to bot.py
M1-T3.description: Commands /profile, /achievements, /resonance, /ask. Read/write gardener.json via local files.
M1-T3.note: Extend existing bot, do not create from scratch

M1-T4.title: Security & Ahimsa-guardrails
M1-T4.description: Audit GITHUB_TOKEN usage, implement soft-fail for bot, add graceful exit mechanism, define silence policy
M1-T4.note: Added based on Grok's analysis. Critical for production readiness.

M2.name: Integration
M2.goal: Connect components: gardener questionnaire, Dashboard Phase 1, GitHub API integration

M2-T1.title: Implement gardener questionnaire in bot
M2-T1.description: Dialog questionnaire: interests, goals, life areas. Results populate gardener.json sota.

M2-T2.title: Dashboard Phase 1: basic visualization
M2-T2.description: HTML/Streamlit dashboard: resonance graph, list of active tasks, achievements map. Reads gardener.json.

M2-T3.title: Bot integration with GitHub (read/write sota)
M2-T3.description: Bot reads and updates gardener.json via GitHub API (or direct access to repo). Sync saved in real time.

M3.name: Automation
M3.goal: Bring Companion to life: proactive dialogue initiation, Scout Agent, Dashboard Phase 2

M3-T1.title: Gentle Companion: proactive dialogue initiation
M3-T1.description: Bot writes first: morning greeting, evening check, gentle reminders. Scheduler based on resonance_level of gardener.
deliverables: bot.py (updated with scheduler and proactive messages)
M3-T1.note: Ahimsa principle: gently, not intrusively. Gardener can always turn off.

M3-T2.title: Scout Agent integration (RM-003)
M3-T2.description: Use ready Scout Agent (60%) to auto-suggest seeds from seeds/ based on gardener's interests.

M3-T3.title: Dashboard Phase 2: living visualizations
M3-T3.description: Flower of Life of gardener (SVG/D3), tree of goal growth, task constellation. Based on RM-011.

M4.name: Polishing
M4.goal: Living symbiosis: real test with Voodoo, corrections, guide for new gardeners

M4-T1.title: Live test: Voodoo as first gardener
M4-T1.description: 7 days of real use. Morning/evening Companion messages, adding achievements, viewing Dashboard.

M4-T2.title: Corrections based on feedback
M4-T2.description: Prioritized fixes based on real experience. Ahimsa: only what truly hinders growth.
deliverables: updated files based on test results

M4-T3.title: Documentation: guide for new gardeners
M4-T3.description: Simple onboarding guide for new gardeners. What is Garden, Companion, Dashboard  explained without technical details.

M5.name: Cross-Platform Blossom
M5.goal: Native mobile applications for Android and iOS via Flutter, making Garden accessible to everyone
M5.description: After MVP validation (M1-M4), expand Garden to native mobile apps. Flutter allows single codebase for Android, iOS, Web, and Desktop.
why_flutter: Single codebase for all platforms  one Garden, not two
Beautiful Material Design + Cupertino widgets out of the box
High performance  native rendering via Skia
Gentle Companion logic reusable from bot.py (ported to Dart)
Aligned with Ahimsa  minimal resource duplication

estimated_effort.ios_app: 1 week (mostly Apple Developer account setup and review)

notes: Telegram bot already works on all platforms  native app is enhancement, not blocker
Push notifications on iOS require Apple Developer account (~$99/year)
Gentle Companion's Ahimsa aligns well with Apple's review guidelines

success_metrics.M1_done: Voodoo has personal sota, bot responds to /profile
success_metrics.M2_done: Questionnaire completed, Dashboard shows real-time data
success_metrics.M3_done: Companion initiated dialogue at least 3 times, Scout suggested seeds
success_metrics.M4_done: 7 days of living symbiosis completed, Voodoo satisfied with their Garden
